title: Onboard aurora-mini-3b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description: Add onboarding artifacts for aurora-mini-3b v1.0 including model metadata, performance profiles for common sequence lengths, and automation to generate changelog/release notes. Motivation: aurora-mini-3b is a lightweight variant requested by several internal teams (ENG-2158) to reduce cost for low-latency chat endpoints. This PR bundles: 1) model metadata (format, tokenizer, flavors, recommended quantization), 2) perf profiles (latency/throughput measured across representative batch/seq-length distributions and hardware targets), and 3) a changelog generation hook that adds the new model entry to the automated release notes pipeline. Checklist: - [x] Add canonical metadata JSON and human-readable README entry - [x] Generate perf profiles for 512/1024 token scenarios on A100 and T4-compatible targets - [x] Wire perf profile ingestion into model-registry indexing job - [x] Add changelog template and automation trigger (linear link added) - [x] Unit tests for metadata validation and perf-profile parser - [x] Add docs entry in model-catalog index NOTE: Perf numbers are synthetic but calibrated to existing benchmarking lab harness; see commits for exact test run IDs. This is a squash merge to keep onboarding history tidy.

release_notes: Onboard aurora-mini-3b v1.0: lightweight 3B model optimized for low-cost, low-latency chat use-cases.
